# Chart.js (vendored)

`chart.umd.min.js` is a copy of **Chart.js v4.x** (UMD build) so the dashboard does
not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.

- Source: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
- License: **MIT** (Copyright © 2014-2024 Chart.js Contributors)
- How to refresh: `npm pack chart.js@<version>` (or `bun add chart.js` then copy
  `node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.min.js` here) and bump this note.

Full license text: <https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/master/LICENSE.md>
